title: Separable elements and separable algebraic field extensions
statement: Let $K/F$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] and $F[T]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. For $\alpha\in K$ algebraic over $F$ [def-weil-algebraic-element], the *minimal polynomial* $P_\alpha\in F[T]$ of $\alpha$ over $F$ is the monic polynomial of least degree with $P_\alpha(\alpha)=0$; it is the monic generator of the (nonzero) kernel of $F[T]\to K$, $T\mapsto\alpha$, and is irreducible. The element $\alpha$ is *separable over $F$* if $P_\alpha$ is separable [def-pc-separable-polynomial] (coprime to its derivative). The extension $K/F$ is *separable algebraic* (an algebraic extension that is separable) if every element of $K$ is algebraic over $F$ and separable over $F$.
